breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory boundary conditions: both Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0) on the same boundaries. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly omits the contradictory Dirichlet condition and only includes the Neumann conditions, thus resolving the inconsistency in alignment with the ground truth.
